title: Masterwork: a production line for an agent's character
description:
Masterwork makes the piece; it does not score it. A model reads a corpus of craft tales and is asked, one axis at a time, what it will hold to — anchorless, in one sitting, with no earlier commitment in view — and then distils its own answers into a standing text that becomes the identity it reads on every later request. The candidate is sealed with everything needed to produce it again: corpus hash, question order, sampling seed, and the sampling profile it was made under.

What the line will not do is judge its own work. Measurement is handed to journeyman, a separate benchmark, through its command line rather than an import, so the stamp travels with the claim; a run the judge marked self-judged cannot reach a threshold, and a gate that could not measure holds rather than passing. Labelling that needs a human or another model is blind by construction, and the line stops and says so rather than inventing a number. Standard library only, apart from the judge.
